_notes: READY-TO-EDIT optimizer config for MyClaude_V61 — Pass C (FILTER ABLATION).
Goal: find out whether each filter earns its keep by toggling them on/off and
comparing the result set. Run AFTER Pass A and Pass B.
increment > 0  -> SWEPT.   increment == 0 -> IGNORED (set it MANUALLY in the study).
SET MANUALLY before running:
Pass A winner: Range Filter Period (27), Range Filter Multiplier (28), RQK Lookback (29)
Pass B winner: Stop ATR x (1), TP1 Mult (4), TP2 Mult (6), Trail ATR x (8)
Enablement/safety: Enable Order Submission (35)=Yes, ALLOW LIVE (36)=No,
FLATTEN NOW (39)=No, Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode = ON
When the VOLUME filter is ON in a combo, these are used (set them sensibly):
Volume Filter Multiplier (43)=1.5, Volume MA Length (44)=20
When the CHOPPINESS filter is ON in a combo, these are used:
Choppiness Limit (33)=61.8, Choppiness Length (34)=14
Keep Long Only (41) at your chosen value for ALL combos so the ablation is fair.
SWEPT below (the ablation knobs):
- Trend Filter MA Length (40): 0 = OFF, else longs only ABOVE the MA. Values 0/100/200/300.
- Volume Filter (42): 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.
- Enable Choppiness Filter (32): 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.
REPLAY MODE: keep replayMode = 1 (Standard); mode 2 can yield ZERO trades.
WARM-UP: trendLen sweeps up to 300, so start the replay at least ~300 bars before
your evaluation window or the longest-MA combos won't trade early on.
READING IT: filters CUT trades, so do NOT judge on Total P/L alone. Compare
risk-adjusted metrics (Sharpe, Profit Factor, Max Drawdown) AND trade count — a
filter earns its keep only if it improves quality enough to justify the trades it removes.
Pass C = 4 x 2 x 2 = 16 combinations.
